scope: Fake DOM unit checks; not browser or assistive-technology verification

tests.name: Progressive enhancement unhides controls; HTML carries initial selected state
Successful switch commits image, alt, caption, original and selected state atomically
404 preserves last valid image and all associated description/link
Newest choice wins even when older success arrives later
Older failure cannot overwrite new success or reveal retry
Initial 404 announces no success, not imaginary previous image
Initial 404 can recover through alternate image
Retry uses failed selection then clears error on success
Repeated currently selected click avoids unnecessary image load
Selecting current while another image is pending cancels stale result
Initial image succeeds during newer pending request, then 404 still preserves it
